value.rationale: The Frucht graph is a canonical minimum-order example of a cubic graph without nontrivial automorphisms, so symmetry-reduced census shortcuts are not available. Complete temporal classification is a motivated exact invariant on a natural benchmark graph. The sharp 21-update clock exceeds both its 12 vertices and graph diameter 4, while only three of 531441 states attain it, and seven different eventual primitive periods coexist. These exact features, not just implementation or a minor arithmetic improvement, provide a useful reference case for finite excitable-network dynamics. No general-graph claim is necessary to make this complete finite classification meaningful.
